name: Beeline / VimpelCom Yaroslavl Data Center
notes: Beeline's company media describes the Yaroslavl data center/technical center as a key network node. The 2023 update says Beeline expanded the facility sixfold over four years, built five new modules, and increased capacity to more than 1,300 rack places; the 2025 article describes further modernization and Beeline Cloud 2.0/Telco Cloud activity at the Yaroslavl technical center. Public MW capacity not found.

Searches in English and Russian found regional telecom/cloud product pages and articles about a planned RTK-TsOD facility in neighboring Khabarovsk Krai, but no public evidence of a physical data center facility or announced project located in the Jewish Autonomous Oblast/Birobidzhan.

name: Rostelecom / DataDome Chita Data Center
notes: CNews and DCD report DataDome completed the Chita data center for Rostelecom, commissioned in December 2020. The facility is 32 sq m with total power of 72 kW and ten racks up to 5 kW each; Telecom Daily described it as the largest data center in Zabaykalsky Krai.
